Definition: to hurry; figuratively, to be eager with excitement or enjoyment
BiblicalUsage: 1) to haste, make haste, hurry; 1a) (Qal) to make haste; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to show haste, act quickly, hasten, come quickly; 1b2) to enjoy, be excited
